## 보관 원문

> # worldsteel Short Range Outlook — October 2025
>
> - Publisher: World Steel Association (worldsteel)
> - Published: 2025-10-13
> - URL: https://worldsteel.org/media/press-releases/2025/worldsteel-short-range-outlook-october-2025/
> - Collected: 2026-08-19
>
> worldsteel projected global finished-steel demand at about 1,749 Mt in 2025, broadly flat from
> 2024, and forecast a 1.3% increase to 1,773 Mt in 2026. It expected Chinese steel demand to
> decline by about 2.0% in 2025 and 1.0% in 2026. It also forecast that developing economies
> excluding China would grow by 3.4% in 2025 and 4.7% in 2026, with Indian demand growing by
> around 9% across 2025 and 2026. Korea and Japan were expected to remain subdued through 2026.
>
> The release explicitly described the figures as forward-looking judgements subject to risks and
> uncertainties, including trade tensions, manufacturing costs, consumer affordability and local-
> government financial pressure in China.
>
> This archived note is a faithful factual extraction prepared from the official public page. It
> preserves the forecast status of the figures and does not treat the outlook as realised demand.
